scripts.postinstall: git submodule update --init --recursive && node -e "if (require('fs').existsSync('quartz')) { require('child_process').execSync('npm install', {cwd: 'quartz', stdio: 'inherit'}); }"
scripts.install-plugins: cd quartz && npx quartz plugin install
scripts.build: npm run convert && npm run prebuild && npm run install-plugins && cd quartz && npx quartz build
scripts.preview: npm run convert && npm run prebuild && npm run install-plugins && cd quartz && npx quartz build --serve
